# workspace_manage_tool

> Manage code workspaces for remote development via SSH.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `developer` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=workspace_manage_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Manage code workspaces for remote development via SSH.

Operations:
- list: List all workspaces for the tenant
- get: Get workspace details by slug
- create: Create a new workspace AND provision the remote (creates dirs, clones repo, starts container)
- update: Update workspace settings
- test_connection: Test SSH connectivity to the remote server

NOTE: For first-time agent workspace setup, prefer WorkspaceProvisionTool which is
purpose-built for automated agent provisioning. This tool is for general workspace management.

All connection details (hostname, port, ssh_username) and workspace config (repo_url,
allowed_commands, docker_image, etc.) default from the tenant's dev_team Configuration.
Do NOT guess or hardcode these values.

EXAMPLES:

List workspaces:
{operation: "list"}

Get workspace:
{operation: "get", slug: "my-project"}

Create workspace (all connection details default from dev_team config):
{operation: "create", name: "My Project"}

Test connection:
{operation: "test_connection", slug: "my-project"}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | string | yes | Operation to perform. One of: `list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `test_connection`. |
| `slug` | string | no | Workspace slug (for get/update/test_connection) |
| `name` | string | no | Workspace name (for create/update) |
| `description` | string | no | Workspace description. |
| `hostname` | string | no | SSH hostname — defaults from tenant dev_team config. Only set to override. |
| `port` | integer | no | SSH port — defaults from tenant dev_team config. Only set to override. |
| `ssh_username` | string | no | SSH username — defaults from tenant dev_team config. Only set to override. |
| `working_directory` | string | no | Remote path to code directory (for create/update) |
| `default_branch` | string | no | Default git branch (default: main) |
| `workspace_config` | object | no | Workspace configuration (test_command, lint_command, build_command, project_instructions, allowed_commands, auto_manage_container, container_idle_timeout_minutes, etc.) |
| `auto_manage_container` | boolean | no | Enable auto start/stop of Docker container (sets workspace_config.auto_manage_container). Default: false. |
| `container_idle_timeout_minutes` | integer | no | Minutes of inactivity before auto-stopping Docker container (sets workspace_config.container_idle_timeout_minutes). Default: 5. |
| `docker_companion_containers` | array of string | no | Additional containers to start/stop alongside the main container (e.g. redis, postgres). Sets workspace_config.docker_companion_containers. |
| `project_id` | integer | no | Link to a Project record. |
| `agent_id` | integer | no | Link to an LlmAgent record (one you reach) |
